answer: Vouched entry with sponsor liability: a new identity earns only after an established agent vouches for it, and each agent may vouch for a few newcomers per epoch. If a vouched identity proves to be a Sybil, the sponsor loses standing and rewards as well. An honest sponsor risks almost nothing; an attacker raising an ocean of fakes must recruit or corrupt many established agents, a real cost per fake, and fakes sharing a sponsor are purged together when caught. Newcomers start at the nadir of trust, confined to a shallow lagoon of capped earnings while their record grows.
